secrets.name: ATTOM_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. ATTOM Data Solutions API key for the licensed production listing/parcel feed. Without it the app runs on the built-in offline synthetic pilot dataset for Miami-Dade. Obtain from https://api.developer.attomdata.com/

secrets.name: REGRID_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Regrid sandbox API token (https://app.regrid.com/). Powers scans for Bel Air/Beverly Hills, Seattle Eastside (Medina/Hunts Point) and Atherton. Sandbox plan is metered at ~2000 properties/month.
